obligations.description: D01 MANDATORY/CONTEXT_CAPPED: 学習済み再利用可能表現・大規模教師あり・transferの確立。Neocognitron/LeNet context、AlexNet、ResNet。X01: ImageNet-scale教師あり契約。X02: class-label入出力契約。
obligations.rationale: Context-capped scope met: Neocognitron/LeNet predecessor context + AlexNet/ResNet anchors with mechanism, bottleneck and transfer detail. LeNet PDF encoding barrier and Neocognitron paywall do not block the context-level claim. No pre-deep CV expansion.

obligations.description: D02 MANDATORY: 分類からidentity+locationへ。R-CNN系/Faster R-CNN、YOLO系/SSD/RetinaNet operating point、DETR set prediction、DINO detector (self-supervised DINOと区別)、YOLO-World等OV橋。X02: box入出力契約。
obligations.rationale: Region/two-stage, one-stage operating points, DETR set-prediction transition and OV bridge all bound with mechanism detail; DINO detector/ss disambiguated. OWOD remains a D07B footnote by design.

obligations.description: D03 MANDATORY: boxからdense構造へ。FCN、U-Net (segmentation役割のみ)、Mask R-CNN、panoptic、SAM/SAM2 promptable系。X02: mask入出力契約。
obligations.rationale: Dense/instance/panoptic/promptable distinctions bound; SAM dual reading and SAM 2 video bridge recorded. U-Net confined to segmentation role (TS-002 boundary intact). SAM 3 promptable concept segmentation admitted as the late convergence node (P03 primary).

obligations.description: D04 MANDATORY_SUPPORT/HARD_CAP: 4-node allow-list (MiDaS/OpenPose/Visual Genome/DUSt3R)。labelにない空間state、後段が仮定する2D/2.5D/3D state、token化時の得失。同等契約の置換のみ許容、拡大禁止。
obligations.rationale: Four-node support cap met exactly (MiDaS/OpenPose/Visual Genome/DUSt3R) with stated limits; support-substrate purpose fulfilled; refusals (NeRF/3DGS/SLAM/MVS) ledgered, not silently omitted.

obligations.description: D05 MANDATORY/NORMAL_WEIGHT: glyphからlayout/symbolicへ。LayoutLM系/Donut/Pix2Struct、specialist (Nougat/GOT) vs general VLM (default NO_CROSS_MODEL_NUMERIC_COMPARISON、5軸qualitative契約)、retrieval bounded sub-lane。X01: document/markup教師契約。
obligations.rationale: LayoutLM lineage, OCR-free branch, Nougat/GOT specialist poles with failure profiles, Pix2Struct UI bridge and retrieval sub-lane all bound. Specialist-vs-generalist comparison stands on the qualitative five-axis contract; numeric ranking prohibited by contract (G03 concerns same-protocol head-to-head absence, not a coverage deficit).

obligations.description: D06 MANDATORY: patch/token formulationとlabel-free再利用表現。ViT/DeiT/Swin、MAE/DINO/DINOv2、SigLIPと後段encoder reuse。X01: self-supervised/masked/distillation目的契約。
obligations.rationale: Token-formulation and label-free representation lineage complete (ViT/DeiT/Swin/MAE/DINO/DINOv2) and encoder reuse into Qwen established with exact citation binding now specified: SigLIP2-So400m initialization and dynamic-resolution continual training per Qwen3-VL report Vision Encoder section and Qwen3-Omni report section 2.3/Table 1 (read-only verified 2026-10-03; reuse fact in VM-D065 claim-3). Late-cutoff admissions: DINOv3 Gram-anchored refinement, SigLIP 2 staged recipe, AIMv2 autoregressive objective (P06 transitions).

obligations.description: D07A MANDATORY/FULL_WEIGHT: 固定ontologyから言語addressable意味へ。DeViSE/captioning/VQA predecessor、CLIP/ALIGN/SigLIP。評価はzero-shot分類・retrieval (D07B指標と統合禁止)。X01: image-text pair教師契約。X02: text<->image入出力契約。
obligations.rationale: Captioning/VQA predecessors, CLIP addressability break with preserved bag-of-words limitation, and ALIGN/SigLIP variants bound; image-level metric identity never merged with grounding metrics. SigLIP 2 staged alignment recipe admitted (P06 home, P07A support).

obligations.description: D07B MANDATORY/FULL_WEIGHT: 言語概念からbox/mask/coordinate/evidenceへ。Flickr30k/RefCOCO/OVR-CNN/ViLD/RegionCLIP/Detic/GLIP/MDETR/OWL-ViT/Grounding DINO/OWL-ST/LSeg->X-Decoder (OpenSeg/ODISE bounded variant)。CLIP+Grounding DINOへの圧縮禁止。評価はLVIS-rare/ODinW/RefCOCO/phrase Recall@K。X01: caption/grounding/pseudo-label教師契約。
obligations.rationale: Full 12-step minimum chain (phrase task, REC contract, OVD formulation, distillation/region/vocabulary poles, reformulation, modulation, fusion poles, web-scale, OVS branch) plus LVIS eval home; redundancy calls recorded; GoldG composition is an Evidence-depth detail, not a coverage gap. SAM 3 concept grounding and UGround universal grounder admitted (P07B/P12 support).

obligations.description: D08 MANDATORY/FULL_WEIGHT: 別pretrainのvision+LLMからusable VLMへ。Frozen/Flamingo/BLIP-2/InstructBLIP/MiniGPT-4/LLaVA、projector/resampler/Q-Former/cross-attention、visual instruction tuning。X02: embedding/token入出力契約。X03: frozen-component計算効率。
obligations.rationale: Frozen precursor, Flamingo/BLIP-2 anchors, InstructBLIP/MiniGPT-4 bridge gap filled, and LLaVA instruction-tuning anchor bound with distinct connector strategies; no flattening.

obligations.description: D09 MANDATORY/FULL_WEIGHT: multimodal信号のtoken/state化。Qwen2.5-VL/Qwen3-VL/Qwen3-Omni、Whisper/BEATs/CLAP input chain、InternVL3/Molmo2 second-family比較、Gemini系closed endpoint (4-role tagging)、resolution/tiling/resampling/fusion/time-alignment。X03 token/memory/latency必須。audio生成側は除外。
obligations.rationale: Qwen staged recipe, audio-input chain (Whisper/BEATs/CLAP), omni fusion with absolute-time sync, two technically distinct open families (InternVL3 paradigm contrast, Molmo 2 grounding comparator) plus repos; query-driven selective acquisition transition admitted via VM-D112 (static fixed-rate ingest redirected; token/context economics second axis); generation side excluded by boundary. G04/G05 are measurement-reproduction gaps, not fusion-coverage gaps.

obligations.description: D10 MANDATORY/FULL_WEIGHT: evidence useと言語prior/scaffoldの分離。MMMU系/POPE/HallusionBench/MMBench/visual-math、counting/spatial/chart/multi-image/compositional、tool-assisted perception。composite scoreを一般知能とみなさない。X04 failure-attribution必須。
obligations.rationale: Polling (POPE), control-pair attribution (HallusionBench), CircularEval/bilingual (MMBench) and visual-math (MathVista) instruments kept distinct; scaffold-vs-perception attribution discipline recorded; no general-intelligence scores.

obligations.description: D11 MANDATORY/NORMAL_WEIGHT: frame反復からtemporal stateへ。Kinetics/SSv2/Ego4D predecessor、Video-MME/LongVideoBench、Flash-VStream+VStream-QA/StreamingBench (offline long-contextとonline streamingを分離)、SAM2 memory bridge、AV joint。X02: 時間state入出力契約。
obligations.rationale: Action/event/egocentric predecessors, duration-breadth (Video-MME), referred-reasoning (LongVideoBench), streaming system (Flash-VStream) and streaming eval (StreamingBench) bound; query-driven selective acquisition admitted via VM-D112 as the third video-processing contract (stored-timeline navigation, neither offline breadth nor online state); offline vs online contracts never share a metric column.

obligations.description: D12 MANDATORY_ENDPOINT/BOUNDED: 知覚からelement grounding、action、persistent task stateへ。OSWorld 1.0/2.0、ScreenSpot/SeeClick、web-agent predecessor context、interface契約比較 (vision/a11y-DOM/API)。state管理thesis。X03 screenshot-loop cost。
obligations.rationale: OSWorld grounding thesis, OSWorld 2.0 state-management thesis with cost curves, ScreenSpot pure-localization accuracy and interface-contract comparison bound; endpoint bounded, no agent-survey expansion. UGround vision-only interface and ScreenSpot-Pro professional evaluation admitted (P12 supporting).

obligations.description: D13 MANDATORY_ENDPOINT/HARD_CAP: 表現からphysical action interfaceへ。SayCan/RT-1/PaLM-E/OpenX/RT-2/OpenVLA/Gemini Robotics系。各nodeのrepresentation/interface契約変化のみで選定。独立評価希薄はEVIDENCE_GAP。
obligations.rationale: Seven-node minimum chain complete (planner-side, data regime, joint representation, cross-embodiment data, action tokenization, open implementation, card-scoped endpoint) within the representation/action interface; residual is G01: independent/non-vendor VLA evaluation scarcity bounds policy-evaluation claims. pi-zero flow-matching interface and FAST tokenization admitted as representation transitions (P13 primary/supporting).

obligations.description: D14 MANDATORY_ENDPOINT/HARD_CAP/TERMINOLOGY_SPLIT: 4-pole (historical定式/latent dynamics Dreamer系/non-generative predictive V-JEPA系/generative interactive Genie系)。各候補はstate/target/conditioning/pixel-latent-reward/useをbind。pixel列のみはTS-002参照。
obligations.rationale: Four-pole separation established (historical formulation, Dreamer latent dynamics, JEPA/V-JEPA predictive representation, Genie interactive generative) with anti-collapse rows and non-ancestry guard; residual is G02: no transferable control-oriented world-model benchmark, bounding dynamics-usability claims. V-JEPA 2/2-AC action-conditioned planning admitted as intra-pole transition (action-free pretraining plus action-conditioned post-training and planning use); transferable control-oriented benchmark still absent (G02 preserved).

obligations.description: D15 MANDATORY/METHODOLOGY_FIRST: task identity保持、契約比較。DocVQA/ChartQA/OCRBench v2/POPE+HallusionBench/ScreenSpot/OSWorld/Video-MME/LongVideoBench/StreamingBench/VSI-Bench retain-set (distinct contractのみ、count最大化禁止)。version/config/judge/tool/budget/contamination/source-role binding。X01 supervision-timeline synthesisとconvergence verdict (unified-vs-modular)。
obligations.rationale: Retain-set benchmarks with distinct contracts, ANLS/relaxed-accuracy/private-set disciplines, version/config/judge/budget/contamination binding rules and vendor-vs-independent separation; catalogue and cross-task ranking refused.
